_help: OPTIONAL display settings. The app finds and runs every model in models/ without this file. Add an entry (matched by model name, e.g. VGG16 for VGG16_final.keras) to set: label, short, kind (proposed | baseline | ablation | custom), desc, order (number, lower = first), default (true = selected at start), hidden (true = do not show), preprocess (auto | 0-1 | 0-255 | -1-1 | caffe | torch), class_names (list). Entries for models you do not have are ignored.

Hybrid_CNN_ViT.label: LAG-HViT (proposed hybrid)
Hybrid_CNN_ViT.desc: Lesion-attention-guided hybrid CNN-Vision Transformer: the CNN lesion map steers the transformer (lesion-biased attention), gated fusion, deep supervision.

EfficientNetB7.label: EfficientNetB7
EfficientNetB7.desc: ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNetB7 on the shared v21 trunk.

VGG16.label: VGG16
VGG16.desc: ImageNet-pretrained VGG16 on the shared v21 trunk.

RegNetY008.label: RegNetY-008
RegNetY008.desc: RegNetY-style network (grouped conv + squeeze-excitation), trained from scratch.

CNN_Only.label: Custom CNN
CNN_Only.desc: The proposal's custom convolutional network, trained from scratch.

NaiveConcat_CNN_ViT.label: Naive concat (ablation)
NaiveConcat_CNN_ViT.desc: Hybrid without lesion bias, lesion pooling and gated fusion.

ViT_Branch.label: ViT branch only (ablation)
ViT_Branch.desc: Transformer branch alone on the CNN-stem tokens.

Hybrid_CNN_ViT_noCAMreg.label: Hybrid without CAM regulariser (ablation)
Hybrid_CNN_ViT_noCAMreg.desc: Proposed hybrid trained without the Leaf-Focus loss.
